label.name: Name
footer.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.
invite.expires7: This invite link will expire in 7 days.
welcome.subject: Welcome to CodeSpectra, {name}!
welcome.heading: Welcome to CodeSpectra, {name}!
welcome.intro: Your account is ready. Here are some things you can do to get started:
welcome.step1Desc: Link your code for automated scanning and review
welcome.step2Desc: Practice coding challenges and interview problems
welcome.step3Desc: Compete solo or with your team in timed events
welcome.step4Desc: Add your skills and experience to get noticed
login.subject: New sign-in detected — CodeSpectra
login.heading: New sign-in detected
login.intro: Hi **{name}**, we noticed a new sign-in to your account.
login.notYou: If this wasn't you, [secure your account]({url}) immediately.
job.subject: Application received — {jobTitle}
job.heading: Application submitted!
job.intro: Hi **{name}**, your application has been received.
examStarted.subject: Exam started: {examTitle}
examStarted.heading: Exam in progress
examStarted.intro: Hi **{name}**, you've begun **{examTitle}**. Keep these in mind:
examStarted.tip1: Watch the timer — auto-submit is enforced when time expires
examStarted.tip2: Read each question carefully before answering
examStarted.tip3: Use the built-in IDE for coding questions
examStarted.tip4: Don't navigate away — tab switches are logged
subscription.subject: Welcome to {plan} — subscription active
subscription.heading: Subscription confirmed!
subscription.intro: Thank you for upgrading to **{plan}**. Your subscription is now active.
subscription.manageNote: You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your billing settings.
invoice.subject: Invoice #{invoiceId} — {plan}
invoice.heading: Invoice available
invoice.intro: Your latest invoice for **{plan}** is ready.
paySuccess.subject: Payment successful — {plan}
paySuccess.heading: Payment successful!
paySuccess.intro: Your payment of **{amount}** for **{plan}** has been processed.
payFailed.subject: Payment failed — {plan}
payFailed.heading: Payment failed
payFailed.intro: Your payment of **{amount}** for **{plan}** could not be processed.
payFailed.retryNote: Please try again or use a different payment method.
reset.subject: Reset your CodeSpectra password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.intro: Click the button below to set a new password. This link expires in **1 hour**.
reset.ignore: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email. Your account won't be affected.
verify.subject: Verify your CodeSpectra email
verify.heading: Verify your email address
verify.intro: Click the button below to confirm your email and activate your CodeSpectra account.
verify.ignore: If you didn't create a CodeSpectra account, ignore this email.
teamInvite.subject: You're invited to join {team} on CodeSpectra
teamInvite.heading: Team invitation
teamInvite.intro: **{inviter}** invited you to join **{team}** on CodeSpectra.
orgInvite.subject: You're invited to join {org} on CodeSpectra
orgInvite.heading: Organization invitation
orgInvite.intro: **{inviter}** invited you to join **{org}** on CodeSpectra.
orgInvite.body: Once you accept, you'll be a member of **{org}** and get access to their team's assessments, exams and codeathons.
atsInvite.subject: Join the {org} hiring team on CodeSpectra
atsInvite.heading: You're invited to a hiring team
atsInvite.intro: **{inviter}** invited you to help **{org}** hire on CodeSpectra as **{role}**.
atsInvite.introClient: **{inviter}** invited you to help **{org}** hire on CodeSpectra as **{role}** for **{client}**.
atsInvite.body: Accept with this email address. If you don't have a CodeSpectra account yet, you can create one on the next screen.
atsInvite.expires: This link expires in {days} days. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.
backup.subject: 2FA backup codes — CodeSpectra
backup.heading: Two-factor authentication enabled
backup.intro: Your backup codes are below. **Store them somewhere safe** — each code can only be used once.
backup.note: If you lose access to your authenticator app, use a backup code to sign in. Then set up 2FA again for full security.
assessInvite.subject: You're invited to complete "{examTitle}" — CodeSpectra Assessment
assessInvite.heading: Assessment Invitation
assessInvite.intro: You have been invited to complete a technical assessment on CodeSpectra.
assessInvite.tip1: Timed assessment with auto-submit when time expires
assessInvite.tip2: Mix of question types (MCQ, coding, descriptive, and more)
assessInvite.tip3: Proctoring is active — tab switches are logged
assessInvite.tip4: Results are reviewed by the technical team
assessInvite.oneTime: **One-time use:** This invite link can only be used once. Do not share it with anyone. It expires on {expires}.
assessResults.subject: Your results are ready: "{examTitle}" — CodeSpectra Assessment
assessResults.heading: Assessment Results Ready
assessResults.intro: Your assessment results for **{examTitle}** have been released by the evaluator.
assessResults.note: Log in to your candidate dashboard to view detailed feedback for each question.
assessReminder.subject: Reminder: "{examTitle}" assessment awaits — CodeSpectra
assessReminder.heading: Assessment Reminder
assessReminder.intro: This is a friendly reminder that you have a pending assessment **{examTitle}** on CodeSpectra.
assessReminder.tip1: Timed assessment — make sure you have uninterrupted time
assessReminder.expires: This invite link expires on {expires}. Complete your assessment before then.
levelUp.subject: Level up! You're now Level {level} 🎉
levelUp.heading: Congratulations, {name}!
levelUp.intro: You just reached **Level {level}** with a total of **{xp} XP**. Keep learning, practicing and competing to climb even higher.
levelUp.note: Your certificate is verified on the public verify page — share it anywhere.
cert.subject: Your {title} certificate is ready 🎓
cert.heading: Certificate issued, {name}!
cert.intro: You've been issued the **{title}** certificate. It's verifiable, downloadable and ready to share.
newsletter.why: You're receiving this because you subscribed to CodeSpectra updates.
account.subject: Your {org} account is ready — CodeSpectra
account.heading: Welcome to CodeSpectra, {name}!
account.intro: An account has been created for you on **{org}**.
account.changePassword: Please sign in and change your password immediately. Do not share these credentials.
account.step2: Enter your email address and the password provided by your admin
account.step3: We recommend changing your password after your first sign-in
hack.invite.subject: Join {team} for {event} — Team Invite
hack.invite.heading: You're invited to join a hackathon team!
hack.invite.intro: **{inviter}** invited you to join **{team}** for the upcoming event:
hack.starting.subject: {event} starts in {startsAt}!
hack.starting.heading: Event starting soon!
hack.starting.intro: Hi, your team **{team}** is registered for **{event}**.
hack.starting.note: Make sure all team members are ready. Good luck! 🚀
hack.ending.subject: {event} ending in {endsAt} — submit now!
hack.ending.heading: ⏰ Event ending soon!
hack.ending.intro: Hi **{team}**, **{event}** ends in **{endsAt}**. Submit all your solutions now!
hack.judge.subject: You've been assigned as a judge — {event}
hack.judge.heading: Judge assignment
hack.judge.intro: Hi **{name}**, you've been assigned as a judge for **{event}**.
hack.judge.body: As a judge, you'll review team submissions, provide scores and feedback. The leaderboard is hidden until results are released.
hack.joined.subject: You're in! Joined {team} for {event}
hack.joined.heading: You've joined {team}!
hack.joined.intro: Hi **{name}**, you're now a member of **{team}** for **{event}**.
hack.results.subject: Results are out! {event} — Your team ranked {medal}
hack.results.heading: Results are here!
hack.results.intro: The results for **{event}** are now available. Here's how your team did:
hack.results.note: Download your certificate and share your achievement on LinkedIn.
hack.detailed.subject: {event} — Detailed team report for {team}
hack.detailed.heading: Detailed Results — {event}
hack.detailed.intro: Hi **{team}**, here's your complete performance breakdown.
auto.dunning.subjectFirst: Your CodeSpectra payment didn’t go through
auto.dunning.subjectFinal: Last notice: your CodeSpectra plan is about to end
auto.dunning.heading: We couldn’t take your payment
auto.dunning.body: We couldn’t renew {plan}. Your access continues until {date} — update your card before then to keep it.
auto.dunning.reason: You got this email because a payment for your CodeSpectra plan failed.
auto.dunning.subject: Reminder: please update your payment method
mkt.mail.why: You get this e-mail because of an order on CodeSpectra.
mkt.mail.confirmed.subject: Order {number} confirmed
mkt.mail.confirmed.heading: Thanks — order {number} is confirmed
mkt.mail.confirmed.body: We received your payment. Here is what you bought:
mkt.mail.failed.subject: Payment for order {number} did not go through
mkt.mail.failed.heading: Your payment did not go through
mkt.mail.failed.body: We could not take the payment for order {number}, so nothing was charged and the items were released. Your cart is still saved — you can try again any time.
mkt.mail.shipped.subject: Shipped: {title}
mkt.mail.shipped.heading: Your item is on its way
mkt.mail.booked.subject: Booked: {title}
mkt.mail.booked.heading: Your session is booked
mkt.mail.booked.linkLater: The host will share the meeting link before the session — it will appear on your order page.
mkt.mail.reminder.subject: Reminder: {title} starts soon
mkt.mail.reminder.heading: Your session starts soon
mkt.mail.downloads.subject: Your downloads are ready (order {number})
mkt.mail.downloads.heading: Your downloads are ready
mkt.mail.downloads.body: Download links are on your order page. For your security each link works for a few minutes and the number of downloads may be limited.
mkt.mail.refund.subject: Refund of {amount} processed
mkt.mail.refund.heading: Your refund is on its way
mkt.mail.refund.body: We refunded {amount} for {items} (order {number}). It usually reaches your account in 5–7 working days.
mentor.mail.why: You get this e-mail because of a mentoring session on CodeSpectra.
mentor.mail.booked.subject: New session booked: {title}
mentor.mail.booked.heading: A learner booked a session
mentor.mail.booked.joinStudio: Join from your mentor studio when the session starts.
mentor.mail.booked.shareLink: Share the meeting link with the learner from your seller dashboard.
mentor.mail.rescheduled.subject: Rescheduled: {title}
mentor.mail.rescheduled.headingLearner: Your session has a new time
mentor.mail.updatedIcs: An updated calendar invite is attached.
auto.reasonDefault: You got this email because of your CodeSpectra account.
auto.verify.subject: One step left: confirm your email
auto.verify.heading: Confirm your email to get started
auto.verify.body: You’re nearly set up. Sign in and press “Resend verification” on your dashboard to get a fresh link — it unlocks tests, events and certificates.
auto.verify.reason: You got this email because you created a CodeSpectra account.
auto.tips.subject: Three quick ways to start on CodeSpectra
auto.tips.heading: Welcome, {name}
auto.tips.body:
1. Solve today’s practice problem — ten minutes is enough to start a streak.
2. Take a short mock test to see where you stand.
3. Browse upcoming hackathons and register with friends.
auto.tips.reason: You got this email because you recently created a CodeSpectra account.
auto.cart.subject: Your cart is waiting
auto.cart.body: You started a checkout on the CodeSpectra marketplace but didn’t finish. Items aren’t held for long — pick up where you left off while they’re still available.
auto.cart.reason: You got this email because you started a checkout on CodeSpectra.
auto.back.subject: Today’s coding challenge is waiting
auto.back.heading: Ready for a quick one, {name}?
auto.back.body: A ten-minute problem is the easiest way to keep your skills sharp. Today’s challenge is ready.
auto.back.subjectLong: We saved your progress — come back anytime
auto.back.bodyLong: Your problems, certificates and progress are still here. New practice problems and events were added while you were away.
auto.back.reason: You got this email because you have a CodeSpectra account and haven’t signed in for a while.
auto.cert.subject: Add your “{title}” certificate to LinkedIn
auto.cert.heading: Show off your certificate
auto.cert.body: Congratulations again, {name}! Recruiters can check your “{title}” certificate in one click. Add it to your LinkedIn profile — the details are filled in for you.
auto.cert.reason: You got this email because you earned a certificate on CodeSpectra.
auto.expiry.subject_one: Your CodeSpectra plan ends in {count} day
auto.expiry.subject_other: Your CodeSpectra plan ends in {count} days
auto.expiry.heading_one: One day left on your plan
auto.expiry.body: Your {plan} ends on {date}. Renew now to keep your tests, events and certificates without a break.
auto.expiry.reason: You got this email because your CodeSpectra plan is ending.
auto.autoSubmit.subject: We submitted your answers for {title}
auto.autoSubmit.heading: Your answers were submitted for you
auto.autoSubmit.body_one: The time for “{title}” ran out before you pressed Submit, so we submitted the {count} answer that was saved. Nothing else is needed from you — you’ll hear when results are released.
auto.autoSubmit.body_other: The time for “{title}” ran out before you pressed Submit, so we submitted the {count} answers that were saved. Nothing else is needed from you — you’ll hear when results are released.
auto.autoSubmit.reason: You got this email because you started this test on CodeSpectra.
auto.receipt.subject: We received your answers for {title}
auto.receipt.heading: Submission received
auto.receipt.body: Thanks — your answers for “{title}” are safely stored. You’ll get an email when results are released.
auto.receipt.reason: You got this email because you submitted a test on CodeSpectra.
hiringDigest.subject: {org} hiring this week · {range}
hiringDigest.heading: Your weekly hiring digest
hiringDigest.intro: Here is how hiring at {org} went from {range}.
hiringDigest.why: You get this because your organisation turned on the weekly hiring digest on CodeSpectra.
